parlays.title: 3-leg easy props at FanDuel
parlays.correlation: One leg per game, so the book prices the ticket as the legs multiplied.
parlays.edge: For fun, not value: each leg is an easier line our projection clears comfortably (81% or better on our numbers, which are tuned for main lines), priced at FanDuel's own alternate-line price and multiplied to +255. A quarter unit, kept with the longshots.
parlays.cutoff: A fun parlay is not re-entered. It stands or falls as posted.
parlays.why: Easy props, for fun: 3 legs at FanDuel, one per game, each an easier line our projection clears comfortably. A quarter unit, tracked with the longshots, apart from the straight picks.
parlays.risk: Every leg has to hit; one miss sinks the ticket. Our player chances are tuned for main lines, so these legs are not value, just fun. A player who does not take the field voids his leg under the book's rule.
parlays.settlementReason: One leg lost; the ticket loses.
